review_type: independent targeted document review, not physical testing
decision: Core document distinctions improved; device plans and citation completeness need changes. Do not directly hand these cases to a tester.

criteria.notes: Preserved built-with SDK Q can versus target P permission and target UDC type requirement. Explicitly lists exceptions and survival guarantees as not established.
Distinguishes interface cancellation from app-switcher closing without notification, with user-action/foreground preconditions. Ancillary wording still needs tightening.
Identifies notification publisher/version distinctions and does not use the overview alone to prove AVSession and every task type behave identically.
All answers remain low, latest-stable scope unresolved, no unsupported-platform assertion or claimed physical results. These are three questions, not a complete node.
Static document questions are separated from device work, but proposed HarmonyOS cases omit important preconditions and assert an unproven audio outcome.
All 17 citation ranges match the supplied bytes. However, the HarmonyOS muting/freezing claim is in line 45, which no citation covers; a real line reference alone does not prove coverage.

required_changes.issue: The no-AVSession audio case does not specify a stream type for which AVSession is not required. Using the listed media/game streams would violate the cited precondition and confound the observation.
required_changes.action: First verify an eligible non-AVSession stream/task in official documentation; otherwise defer this case. Record stream type and valid baseline.

required_changes.issue: Stopping the long-running task is rewritten as guaranteed audio stopping. Line 7 only specifies stopping the long-running task.
required_changes.action: Measure task cancellation and audio playback separately. Treat audio outcome as observation pending evidence, not the documented pass criterion.

required_changes.issue: Muting/freezing and foreground recovery are mentioned without citing their supplied paragraph.
required_changes.action: Add a precise citation to line 45 or remove this nonessential detail.

required_changes.issue: A device observation cannot establish an official API contract; the transfer case also needs to distinguish system-managed and non-managed transfer.
required_changes.action: Report only behavior of the selected phone/build, and specify a supported transfer implementation before execution.

wording_notes: HarmonyOS API19-and-earlier wording should retain the subject 'background-task module', not imply no notification from any publisher.
For iOS, say normal completion returns success; do not imply all non-user-cancelled tasks succeed, because line 170 also lists code errors and system expiration.
The proposed BGTask protocol label is not established by the supplied body; describe it neutrally as the referenced API until checked.
Reading every other Service method is not a prerequisite for this bounded question; keep possible future module research separate from required missing evidence.
